jobs.title: Electrical technician in research high voltage lab 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
As high voltage lab engineer, you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology to be used in high voltage products.
In this position, you can test innovative ideas, implement new measurement and diagnostics methods, while you maintain a functional and safe testing environment.
Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology and work towards a sustainable and exciting future in energy.

How you will make an impact:

• Run and maintain state-of-the-art high voltage labs

• Participate actively in planning, preparation and execution of high voltage tests

• Collaborate closely with a team of scientists and technicians from research

• Bring your active contribution to the definition of safe testing practices in the lab during all phases of the experiments with the support of local HSE partners and research team

• Interact with partners in the adjacent Hitachi Energy high voltage labs and business units.

What you will bring:

• Education in electrical engineering with at least a bachelor degree (FH)

• Proven experience in lab work, including experimental setup with advanced measurement methods

• Knowledge of lab integrated programming using LabView, Matlab or Python is very much welcome

• Skills in data analysis are a plus.

• Past experience in high voltage lab is advantageous.

• Conversational level in English is required, good knowledge of German language is very appreciated.

More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.
If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Come ingegnere di laboratorio ad alta tensione, sei un membro completo di un team dinamico di scienziati e tecnici che lavorano per modellare la tecnologia futura da utilizzare nei prodotti ad alta tensione.
In questa posizione, è possibile testare idee innovative, implementare nuovi metodi di misurazione e diagnostica, mentre si mantiene un ambiente di test funzionale e sicuro.
Vieni a unirsi al nostro team se sei interessato al campo della tecnologia ad alta tensione e lavorare verso un futuro sostenibile ed emozionante nell'energia.

Come si farà un impatto:

• Eseguire e mantenere laboratori ad alta tensione all'avanguardia

• Partecipa attivamente alla pianificazione, preparazione ed esecuzione di test ad alta tensione

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con un team di scienziati e tecnici della ricerca

• Porta il tuo contributo attivo alla definizione di pratiche di prova sicure in laboratorio durante tutte le fasi degli esperimenti con il supporto dei partner HSE locali e del team di ricerca

• Interagire con i partner nell'adiacente Hitachi Energy laboratori ad alta tensione e unità aziendali.

Cosa porterai:

• Istruzione in ingegneria elettrica con almeno una laurea (FH)

• Esperienza dimostrata nel lavoro di laboratorio, inclusa la configurazione sperimentale con metodi di misura avanzati

• La conoscenza della programmazione integrata del laboratorio utilizzando LabView, Matlab o Python è molto gradita

• Le competenze nell'analisi dei dati sono un vantaggio.

• L'esperienza passata in laboratorio ad alta tensione è vantaggiosa.

• Livello di conversazione in inglese è richiesto, buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca è molto apprezzato.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

A Hitachi Energy, crediamo nel potere della diversità e del potenziale di ogni persona. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo in cui tutti possano prosperare. Vi invitiamo a candidarvi e unirvi a noi nella definizione di un futuro sostenibile.
Se siete desiderosi di guidare l'innovazione in un ambiente di ricerca dinamico, applicare!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance
Als Hochspannungslaboringenieur sind Sie vollwertiges Mitglied eines dynamischen Teams von Wissenschaftlern und Technikern, die daran arbeiten, die zukünftige Technologie für Hochspannungsprodukte zu gestalten.
In dieser Position können Sie innovative Ideen testen, neue Mess- und Diagnosemethoden implementieren und gleichzeitig eine funktionale und sichere Testumgebung pflegen.
Treten Sie unserem Team bei, wenn Sie sich für die Hochspannungstechnik interessieren und auf eine nachhaltige und spannende Zukunft im Energiebereich hinarbeiten.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden:

• Betrieb und Wartung modernster Hochspannungslabore

• Aktiv an der Planung, Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Hochspannungstests teilnehmen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team von Wissenschaftlern und Technikern aus der Forschung

• Bringen Sie Ihren aktiven Beitrag zur Definition sicherer Testpraktiken im Labor in allen Phasen der Experimente mit Unterstützung lokaler HSE-Partner und Forschungsteams ein

• Interagieren Sie mit Partnern in den benachbarten Hochspannungslabors und Geschäftseinheiten von Hitachi Energy.

Was Sie mitbringen werden:

• Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik mit mindestens einem Bachelor-Abschluss (FH)

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Laborarbeit, einschließlich der experimentellen Einrichtung mit fortschrittlichen Messmethoden

• Kenntnisse in der integrierten Laborprogrammierung mit LabView, Matlab oder Python sind sehr willkommen

• Fähigkeiten in der Datenanalyse sind ein Plus.

• Erfahrungen aus der Vergangenheit im Hochspannungslabor sind vorteilhaft.

• Gesprächsniveau in Englisch ist erforderlich, gute Deutschkenntnisse werden sehr geschätzt.

Mehr über uns

Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt und das Potenzial jedes Menschen. Wir sind bestrebt, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder gedeihen kann. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben und gemeinsam eine nachhaltige Zukunft zu gestalten.
Wenn Sie Innovationen in einem dynamischen Forschungsumfeld vorantreiben möchten, bewerben Sie sich!

jobs.title: ECAD Service Manager
jobs.description:
Hitachi, Ltd. is seeking an ECAD Service Manager to oversee and optimize our electrical and electronic computer-aided design (ECAD) systems and services. This role is crucial for ensuring the efficient and effective operation of ECAD applications and supporting Hitachi Energy engineering and other value chains globally.

How you will make an Impact:

• Manage and enhance the ECAD service portfolio, ensuring a harmonized and strategically aligned application landscape.
• Lead agile development teams, application managers, project managers, specialists, and external vendors.
• Oversee the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of ECAD applications while ensuring data integrity and consistency.
• Manage the full lifecycle of ECAD applications and environments, including selection, deployment, maintenance, upgrades, and retirement.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements, demand, and strategic objectives.
• Manage vendor relationships, including software and hardware licensing, technical support, and contract negotiations.
• Ensure successful delivery of software development projects in alignment with the Hitachi Energy IT Project Management Framework.
• Develop and implement ECAD best practices, standards, and procedures to improve design efficiency and quality.
• Evaluate and introduce new ECAD technologies and methodologies to enhance productivity and design capabilities.
• Manage budgets for ECAD software, hardware, and services while ensuring compliance with industry standards, company policies, data security requirements, and monitoring system performance and team activities.
Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
• Minimum 8 years of experience in ECAD system administration, development, support, or design engineering roles.
• At least 3 years of leadership or management experience. Proven ability to manage projects, prioritize workloads, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong experience with Agile software development methodologies such as SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban.
• Knowledge of IT service management frameworks, particularly ITIL.
• Extensive hands-on experience with industry-standard ECAD tools, including Zuken E3.series, Altium, or similar platforms.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior business stakeholders.
• Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, purchasing, and cost management.
The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures.​
​This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.​
​
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi, Ltd. sta cercando un Service Manager ECAD per supervisionare e ottimizzare i nostri sistemi e servizi di progettazione elettronica e elettronica (ECAD). Questo ruolo è fondamentale per garantire il funzionamento efficiente ed efficace delle applicazioni ECAD e sostenere l'ingegneria energetica Hitachi e altre catene di valore a livello globale.

Come si farà un impatto:

• Gestire e migliorare il portafoglio di servizi ECAD, garantendo un paesaggio di applicazioni armonizzato e strategicamente allineato.
• Lead agile team di sviluppo, application manager, project manager, specialisti e fornitori esterni.
• Superare lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il miglioramento continuo delle applicazioni ECAD garantendo al tempo stesso integrità e coerenza dei dati.
• Gestisci il ciclo di vita completo delle applicazioni e degli ambienti ECAD, tra cui selezione, distribuzione, manutenzione, aggiornamenti e pensionamento.
• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per comprendere i requisiti, la domanda e gli obiettivi strategici.
• Gestisci le relazioni dei fornitori, inclusi software e licenze hardware, supporto tecnico e trattative contrattuali.
• Assicurare la consegna di progetti di sviluppo software in allineamento con il Quadro di gestione dei progetti IT di Hitachi Energy.
• Sviluppare e implementare le migliori pratiche, standard e procedure ECAD per migliorare l'efficienza e la qualità della progettazione.
• Valutare e introdurre nuove tecnologie e metodologie ECAD per migliorare la produttività e le capacità di progettazione.
• Gestisci i budget per il software, l'hardware e i servizi ECAD, garantendo nel contempo la conformità agli standard del settore, alle politiche aziendali, ai requisiti di sicurezza dei dati e alle prestazioni del sistema di monitoraggio e alle attività del team.
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato; Master's Degree preferito.
• Minimo 8 anni di esperienza nei ruoli di amministrazione, sviluppo, supporto o ingegneria del sistema ECAD.
• Almeno 3 anni di leadership o esperienza di gestione. Prove capacità di gestire i progetti, privilegiare i carichi di lavoro e fornire risultati in un ambiente veloce.
• Forte esperienza con metodi di sviluppo software Agile come SAFe, Scrum e Kanban.
• Conoscenza delle strutture di gestione dei servizi IT, in particolare ITIL.
• Ampia esperienza pratica con gli strumenti ECAD standard del settore, tra cui Zuken E3.series, Altium o piattaforme simili.
• Dimostrata capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team interfunzionali e stakeholder aziendali senior.
• Forte acume finanziario, tra cui bilancio, previsione, acquisto e gestione dei costi.
L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione dei candidati, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza e allineati con le strutture di pagamento interne.
Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva.
​
La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include:

• Competitività e incentivi
• Benessere e cura
• congedo pagato e non pagato
• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi, Ltd. sucht einen ECAD Service Manager, um unsere elektrischen und elektronischen Computer-Aided Design (ECAD) Systeme und Services zu überwachen und zu optimieren. Diese Rolle ist entscheidend für den effizienten und effektiven Betrieb von ECAD-Anwendungen und die Unterstützung von Hitachi Energy Engineering und anderen Wertschöpfungsketten weltweit.

Wie Sie einen Impact erzielen:

• Verwalten und verbessern Sie das ECAD-Serviceportfolio und sorgen Sie für eine harmonisierte und strategisch ausgerichtete Anwendungslandschaft.
• Führen Sie agile Entwicklungsteams, Anwendungsmanager, Projektmanager, Spezialisten und externe Anbieter.
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwicklung, Wartung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von ECAD-Anwendungen bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung der Datenintegrität und -konsistenz.
• Verwalten Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus von ECAD-Anwendungen und -Umgebungen, einschließlich Auswahl, Bereitstellung, Wartung, Upgrades und Ruhestand.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Anforderungen, Nachfrage und strategische Ziele zu verstehen.
• Verwalten von Lieferantenbeziehungen, einschließlich Software- und Hardwarelizenzierung, technischem Support und Vertragsverhandlungen.
• Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Durchführung von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten in Übereinstimmung mit dem Hitachi Energy IT Project Management Framework.
• Entwicklung und Implementierung von ECAD Best Practices, Standards und Verfahren zur Verbesserung der Designeffizienz und -qualität.
• Bewertung und Einführung neuer ECAD-Technologien und -Methoden zur Verbesserung der Produktivität und Designfähigkeiten.
• Verwalten Sie Budgets für ECAD-Software, -Hardware und -Services und gewährleisten Sie gleichzeitig die Einhaltung von Industriestandards, Unternehmensrichtlinien, Datensicherheitsanforderungen sowie die Überwachung der Systemleistung und der Teamaktivitäten.
Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Computertechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Master-Abschluss bevorzugt.
• Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in ECAD Systemadministration, Entwicklung, Support oder Design Engineering Rollen.
• Mindestens 3 Jahre Führungs- oder Managementerfahrung. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Projekte zu verwalten, Workloads zu priorisieren und Ergebnisse in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu liefern.
• Starke Erfahrung mit agilen Softwareentwicklungsmethoden wie SAFe, Scrum und Kanban.
• Kenntnisse über IT Service Management Frameworks, insbesondere ITIL.
• Umfangreiche praktische Erfahrung mit branchenüblichen ECAD-Tools, einschließlich Zuken E3.series, Altium oder ähnlichen Plattformen.
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und Senior Business Stakeholdern.
• Starker finanzieller Scharfsinn, einschließlich Budgetierung, Prognose, Einkauf und Kostenmanagement.
Das endgültige Angebot basiert auf dem Standort, den Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen der Kandidaten, der Erfahrung und wird an den internen Vergütungsstrukturen ausgerichtet sein.
Diese Rolle kann an mehreren Standorten offen sein. Wenn die angegebenen Gehaltsinformationen für Ihren aktuellen Standort nicht gelten, werden die für Ihren Standort relevanten Gehaltsdetails zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt mit Ihnen besprochen.
​
Unser Leistungsangebot ist auf Ihr Beschäftigungsland zugeschnitten und umfasst in der Regel:

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Anreize
• Wohlbefinden und Pflege
• Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub
• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen
• Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen Sie erhalten spezifischere Informationen während des Rekrutierungsprozesses.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Hitachi, Ltd. cherche un gestionnaire de service ECAD pour superviser et optimiser nos systèmes et services de conception assistée par ordinateur (ECAD) électriques et électroniques. Ce rôle est crucial pour assurer le fonctionnement efficace et efficient des applications ECAD et soutenir l'ingénierie Hitachi Energy et d'autres chaînes de valeur à l'échelle mondiale.

Comment vous ferez un impact:

• Gérer et améliorer le portefeuille de services de la CDE, en assurant un paysage d'applications harmonisé et stratégiquement harmonisé.
• Diriger les équipes de développement agile, les gestionnaires d'applications, les gestionnaires de projets, les spécialistes et les fournisseurs externes.
• Surveiller le développement, la maintenance et l'amélioration continue des applications ECAD tout en assurant l'intégrité et la cohérence des données.
• Gérer le cycle de vie complet des applications et des environnements ECAD, y compris la sélection, le déploiement, la maintenance, les mises à niveau et la retraite.
• Collaborer avec les intervenants commerciaux pour comprendre les exigences, la demande et les objectifs stratégiques.
• Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, y compris les licences de logiciels et de matériel, le soutien technique et les négociations contractuelles.
• Assurer la bonne exécution des projets de développement de logiciels conformément au cadre de gestion des projets de TI d'Hitachi Energy.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre les pratiques exemplaires, les normes et les procédures de la CED afin d'améliorer l'efficacité et la qualité de la conception.
• Évaluer et introduire de nouvelles technologies et méthodologies de la CDE pour améliorer la productivité et les capacités de conception.
• Gérer les budgets des logiciels, du matériel et des services ECAD tout en assurant le respect des normes de l'industrie, des politiques de l'entreprise, des exigences en matière de sécurité des données et de la surveillance des performances du système et des activités de l'équipe.
Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en génie électrique, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe; maîtrise préférée.
• Au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans l'administration, le développement, le soutien ou la conception de systèmes ECAD.
• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en leadership ou en gestion. Capacité éprouvée de gérer des projets, de prioriser les charges de travail et de produire des résultats dans un environnement accéléré.
• Forte expérience avec les méthodologies de développement de logiciels Agile telles que SAFe, Scrum et Kanban.
• Connaissance des cadres de gestion des services de TI, en particulier l'ITIL.
• Une vaste expérience pratique avec les outils ECAD standard de l'industrie, y compris Zuken E3.series, Altium, ou des plateformes similaires.
• Capacité démontrée de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes interfonctionnelles et les principaux intervenants commerciaux.
• Forte acuité financière, y compris la budgétisation, les prévisions, les achats et la gestion des coûts.
L'offre finale sera fondée sur l'emplacement des candidats, les compétences et les qualifications, l'expérience et l'alignement sur les structures de paye internes.
Ce rôle peut être ouvert en plusieurs endroits. Si les renseignements sur le salaire énumérés ne s'appliquent pas à votre lieu de résidence actuel, les détails sur le salaire se rapportant à votre lieu de résidence seront discutés avec vous à une étape ultérieure.
​
Notre offre de prestations est adaptée à votre pays d'emploi et comprend généralement:

• Salaire concurrentiel et incitations
• Bien-être et soins
• Congés payés et non payés
• Options de travail flexibles
• Avantages qui appuient votre sécurité financière Vous recevrez des renseignements plus précis au cours du processus de recrutement.

jobs.title: HUB Europe Transformer -Digital Business Process Owner
jobs.description:
Lead the SAP Expert team within BU TR Hub EUC which supports the SAP users as internal business partners to train, improve processes and harmonize the way of working within SAP templates across 17 factories.

Drive digitalization and global program implementation within the HUB by ensuring adherence to standard processes and effective use of core systems across the full value chain - from quotation and engineering to project management, manufacturing, and shipment. Identify, analyze and enhance business processes to enable continuous improvement, innovation, and sustainable growth, while harmonizing operations and resolving user issues. Partner with cross‑functional stakeholders and Digital Transformation Organization (DTO) to enhance organizational efficiency and promote operational excellence.

Key Tasks
• §   Collaborate within Digital Transformation Organization (DTO) to share best practices and drive commonality.
• §   Work with HUB IS and HUB Controller on budget and demand planning.
• §   Lead HUB activities and conduct monthly update sessions with HUB management.
• §   Lead the Hub SAP Expert team as line manager and develop the team members
• §   Coach less experienced staff and provide training to develop new talent.
• §   Drive adoption of globally harmonized processes.
• §   Minimize local customizations in processes.
• §   Communicate benefits of global processes to stakeholders.
• §   Secure stakeholders buy-in for change initiatives.
• §   Assess risks related to change initiatives.
• §   Develop risk mitigation strategies.
• §   Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Requirements
• §   Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field.
• §   Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles related to business process management or digital program implementation in the manufacturing industry.
• §   Minimum 5 years of experience in people management and development

jobs.title: Qualitätsprüfer/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position
Als Qualitätsprüfer/in stellst du sicher, dass eingehende Materialien und Komponenten unseren Qualitätsanforderungen entsprechen. Du prüfst Lieferungen quantitativ und qualitativ, führst Erstmusterprüfungen durch und dokumentierst Abweichungen. Zudem unterstützt du die Qualitätssicherung und Entwicklung mit spezifischen Messaufträgen, wertest Qualitätsdaten aus und leitest geeignete Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der Produktqualität ein. Mit deiner Erfahrung, deinem technischen Verständnis und deiner sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherstellung unserer Qualitätsstandards.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Qualitative und quantitative Prüfung von Materialeingängen mittels mechanischer, elektrischer und optischer Messmittel sowie Kontrolle der zugehörigen Dokumente
• Durchführung von Erstmusterprüfungen inklusive Erstellung der Erstmusterprüfberichte (ZP) und Bearbeitung der erforderlichen PPAP-Dokumentation
• Erstellung von Qualitätsmeldungen zur systematischen Dokumentation von Abweichungen bei eingehenden Lieferungen
• Teilnahme an relevanten Besprechungen zur Förderung des Informationsaustauschs innerhalb der Werke
• Durchführung spezifischer Messaufträge, beispielsweise für die Entwicklung oder die Qualitätssicherung
• Sicherstellung des Unterhalts der IQC-Messmittel und Hilfsmittel
• Erhebung und Auswertung von Statistiken zur Entwicklung von Fehlermeldungen aus der Montage (Z2) sowie Einleitung geeigneter Massnahmen zur Reduktion der Fehler
• Erstellung und Anpassung von Prüfplänen gemäss den Vorgaben von R&D oder TC

Das bringst du mit

• Technische oder berufliche Ausbildung sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Qualitätsprüfung oder einem vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld
• Gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit mechanischen, elektrischen und optischen Messmitteln sowie in der Beurteilung technischer Dokumente
• Erfahrung mit Erstmusterprüfungen, Erstmusterprüfberichten und PPAP von Vorteil
• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, Qualitätsabweichungen zu erkennen, zu bewerten und geeignete Massnahmen abzuleiten
• Sicherer Umgang mit Qualitätsdaten und Statistiken sowie Freude an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prüf- und Produktionsprozessen
• Selbstständige, sorgfältige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen

Mehr über uns
Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen mitzuwirken.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
In qualità di ispettore di qualità, assicura che i materiali e i componenti in arrivo soddisfino i nostri requisiti di qualità. Controllare le consegne quantitativamente e qualitativamente, eseguire i controlli dei campioni iniziali e le deviazioni dei documenti. Inoltre, supporta l'assicurazione della qualità e lo sviluppo con specifici ordini di misura, raccogliere dati di qualità e avviare misure adeguate per migliorare la qualità del prodotto. Con la vostra esperienza, la comprensione tecnica e i metodi di lavoro accurati, apportate un contributo importante per garantire i nostri standard di qualità.

Puoi farlo.

• Test qualitativo e quantitativo di ingressi materiali mediante strumenti di misura meccanica, elettrica e ottica e controllo dei documenti associati
• Attuazione dei test iniziali del campione, compresa la preparazione dei rapporti di prova iniziali (ZP) e l'elaborazione della documentazione PPAP richiesta
• Preparazione di relazioni di qualità per la documentazione sistematica delle deviazioni nelle consegne in entrata
• Partecipazione a riunioni pertinenti per promuovere lo scambio di informazioni all'interno dei lavori
• Eseguire specifici compiti di misura, ad esempio per lo sviluppo o la garanzia di qualità
• Garantire la manutenzione di strumenti e strumenti IQC
• Raccolta e valutazione delle statistiche per lo sviluppo di messaggi di errore dall'assemblea (Z2) e l'avvio di misure adeguate per ridurre gli errori
• Creazione e regolazione dei piani di prova secondo le specifiche di R&D o TC

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione tecnica o professionale nonché esperienza approfondita nel controllo della qualità o in un ambiente di produzione comparabile
• Buona conoscenza nell'uso di apparecchiature di misura meccanica, elettrica e ottica, nonché nella valutazione dei documenti tecnici
• Esperienza con test di tipo iniziale, rapporti di prova di tipo iniziale e PPAP è vantaggioso
• Funzionamento analitico e strutturato nonché la capacità di rilevare, valutare e ricavare misure appropriate
• Gestione sicura dei dati e delle statistiche di qualità e fruizione del continuo miglioramento dei processi di test e produzione
• Metodi di lavoro indipendenti, attenti e responsabili, nonché buone capacità di comunicazione e piacere di lavorare con diverse aree specializzate

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Hitachi Energy sta plasmando il futuro dell'energia con tecnologie innovative per un approvvigionamento energetico sostenibile e affidabile. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, un team forte e l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente a soluzioni orientate al futuro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a quality inspector, you ensure that incoming materials and components meet our quality requirements. You check deliveries quantitatively and qualitatively, perform initial sample checks and document deviations. In addition, you support quality assurance and development with specific measurement orders, collect quality data and initiate suitable measures to improve product quality. With your experience, technical understanding and careful working methods, you make an important contribution to ensuring our quality standards.

You can do that.

• Qualitative and quantitative testing of material inputs by means of mechanical, electrical and optical measuring instruments and control of the associated documents
• Implementation of initial sample tests including preparation of initial sample test reports (ZP) and processing of the required PPAP documentation
• Preparation of quality reports for systematic documentation of deviations in incoming deliveries
• Participation in relevant meetings to promote information exchange within the works
• Carrying out specific measurement tasks, for example for development or quality assurance
• Ensuring the maintenance of IQC instruments and tools
• Collection and evaluation of statistics for the development of error messages from the assembly (Z2) and initiation of suitable measures for reducing errors
• Creation and adjustment of test plans according to the specifications of R&D or TC

You bring that with you

• Technical or vocational training as well as in-depth experience in quality control or a comparable production environment
• Good knowledge in the use of mechanical, electrical and optical measuring equipment as well as in the assessment of technical documents
• Experience with initial type tests, initial type test reports and PPAP is beneficial
• Analytical and structured operation as well as the ability to detect, evaluate and derive appropriate measures
• Safe handling of quality data and statistics as well as enjoyment of the continuous improvement of testing and production processes
• Independent, careful and responsible working methods as well as good communication skills and pleasure in working with different specialist areas

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a quality inspector, you ensure that incoming materials and components meet our quality requirements. You check deliveries quantitatively and qualitatively, perform initial sample checks and document deviations. In addition, you support quality assurance and development with specific measurement orders, collect quality data and initiate suitable measures to improve product quality. With your experience, technical understanding and careful working methods, you make an important contribution to ensuring our quality standards.

You can do that.

• Qualitative and quantitative testing of material inputs by means of mechanical, electrical and optical measuring instruments and control of the associated documents
• Implementation of initial sample tests including preparation of initial sample test reports (ZP) and processing of the required PPAP documentation
• Preparation of quality reports for systematic documentation of deviations in incoming deliveries
• Participation in relevant meetings to promote information exchange within the works
• Carrying out specific measurement tasks, for example for development or quality assurance
• Ensuring the maintenance of IQC instruments and tools
• Collection and evaluation of statistics for the development of error messages from the assembly (Z2) and initiation of suitable measures for reducing errors
• Creation and adjustment of test plans according to the specifications of R&D or TC

You bring that with you

• Technical or vocational training as well as in-depth experience in quality control or a comparable production environment

• Analytical and structured operation as well as the ability to detect, evaluate and derive appropriate measures
• Safe handling of quality data and statistics as well as enjoyment of the continuous improvement of testing and production processes
• Independent, careful and responsible working methods as well as good communication skills and pleasure in working with different specialist areas

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Tendering Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
Would you like to contribute to the energy transition by helping to make the power grid smarter, more environmentally friendly, and more efficient? At Hitachi Energy, our goal is to drive a sustainable energy future for all.

As a Commercial Tendering Specialist, you will have many interesting actions on international tenders, in the field of substation automation, protection and control. You will complete bid submissions together with sales engineers, technical tendering specialists, support functions and you will drive Management approvals.

Join our great international team and participate in our successes.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead commercially large and complex tenders to completion in the field of Substation Automation Systems, Control and Protection, within Hub Europe
• Act as a tender lead, a coordinator with different stakeholders to evaluate all commercial aspects, costs and risks of the tender together with the technical tendering team and the support functions such as legal, supply chain, tax, trade compliance, treasury, finance control
• Prepare complex commercial tendering documentation and cost calculations including financial consolidations, cash flows, in a timely and efficient manner with high quality standards
• Challenge the tender's information, evaluate best project setup, scope of delivery, suitable terms and conditions for the company and support our Sales Managers up to contract negotiations
• Work closely with the Technical Bid Managers for all technical matters
• Support growth initiative and continuous improvement, conduct lessons learned reviews to drive efficiency and quality
• Provide regular feedback and productivity insights to Management
Your background

• At least 5 years' experience in Sales support, Tender Management or Project Management of international/export projects ideally in substation automation, control and protection or in the field of High Voltage substation's projects, ideally for an international OEM Company
• Bachelor or Master degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering or similar
• General understanding of the commercial aspects of a tender (Legal, Tax, Credit Risk Management, Export Control, ….)
• Understanding of site workers assignments overseas, during international project, with secondment or payroll transfer a plus.
• Process-oriented profile with strategic mindset and ability to handle risk management
• A proactive and structured approach to your work, with a strong sense of responsibility
• Ability to work in multi-cultural and virtual teams, delivering results and interacting with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
• Extended communication skills in English, additional language like German, French or Spanish a plus
More about us
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Capacità di lavorare in team multi-culturali e virtuali, offrendo risultati e interagire con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione
• Capacità di comunicazione estesa in inglese, lingua aggiuntiva come tedesco, francese o spagnolo un plus
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Du koordinierst mit Kunden und internen Teams, planst Testabläufe und erstellst präzise technische Dokumentationen. • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Hochspannungstechnik sind zwingend erforderlich

jobs.title: Corporate Strategic Leader (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
Shape the Hitachi Energy corporate strategy and drive growth choices!
Are you ready to help define Hitachi Energy's corporate-level strategic direction and translate it into focused growth priorities?
In our Strategy function, we are looking for a Leader Corporate Strategy who can support overall Hitachi Energy strategy formulation, design and improve strategic processes, structure and drive the integrated growth portfolio, and help senior leaders prioritize opportunities based on strategic attractiveness, financial impact, and execution readiness.

This position offers a flexible European location and can be based in Italy, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland.

How you´ll make an impact
Shape Hitachi Energy's future growth agenda

• Translate market, customer, technology, and financial insights into strategic priorities that drive long-term growth.
• Identify emerging trends, new growth opportunities, and strategic risks across markets and business models.
• Develop executive-level recommendations and scenarios to support key growth and investment decisions.
• Foster alignment across businesses, regions, functions, and the broader strategy community, including collaboration with the Hitachi Group.
Drive enterprise growth governance

• Shape and manage the growth portfolio, providing visibility of strategic opportunities across the organization.
• Support Growth Board prioritization and investment decisions based on value, strategic fit, and execution feasibility.
• Prepare and facilitate Growth Board discussions and ensure decisions translate into clear actions and measurable outcomes.
Generate strategic & financial insights

• Analyze market dynamics, growth drivers, and investment opportunities to inform enterprise strategy.
• Develop long-term forecasts, scenarios, and business cases that guide strategic choices.
• Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
Your background
You are an analytical, structured, and collaborative strategy professional who is comfortable working with ambiguity and engaging senior stakeholders on enterprise-level choices. Specifically, you offer:

• University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus.
• Relevant experience in strategy, sales & marketing, management consulting, corporate development, finance, or strategic planning in an international environment.
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, assess opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
• Experience preparing executive-level materials, facilitating senior meetings, and managing action follow-up across multiple stakeholders.
• Ability to work across business units, regions, and functions with a One Hitachi Energy mindset and strong ownership for outcomes.
• Curiosity about the energy transition, growth markets, technology shifts, and the strategic choices required to inspire the next era of sustainable energy.
• Passion to coach team members and build strategy capabilities by developing common tools, methodologies, templates, and ways of working across the strategy community.
More about us
The minimum salary for this position in the location specified is as follows:​

• Italy: starting from 86,000 EUR (Dirigente)
The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures.​
​This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.​
​
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.​

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Formare la strategia aziendale Hitachi Energy e guidare le scelte di crescita!
Sei pronto ad aiutare a definire la direzione strategica a livello aziendale di Hitachi Energy e a tradurla in priorità di crescita focalizzate?
Nella nostra funzione di strategia, stiamo cercando una strategia aziendale Leader che può supportare la formulazione globale di strategia di Hitachi Energy, progettare e migliorare i processi strategici, strutturare e guidare il portafoglio di crescita integrato, e aiutare i leader senior priorità opportunità basate sull'attrattiva strategica, impatto finanziario e la disponibilità di esecuzione.

Questa posizione offre una posizione europea flessibile e può essere basata in Italia, Germania, Spagna, Regno Unito o Svizzera.

Come farai ad avere un impatto
Il futuro programma di crescita di Hitachi Energy

• Traduci mercato, cliente, tecnologia e approfondimenti finanziari in priorità strategiche che guidano la crescita a lungo termine.
• Identificare tendenze emergenti, nuove opportunità di crescita e rischi strategici sui mercati e sui modelli di business.
• Sviluppare raccomandazioni e scenari a livello esecutivo per sostenere le decisioni chiave di crescita e di investimento.
• Promuovere l'allineamento tra imprese, regioni, funzioni e la più ampia comunità di strategia, compresa la collaborazione con il Gruppo Hitachi.
Gestione della crescita aziendale

• Formare e gestire il portafoglio di crescita, fornendo visibilità delle opportunità strategiche in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Consiglio di crescita di sostegno priorità e decisioni di investimento basate su valore, vestibilità strategica e fattibilità di esecuzione.
• Preparare e facilitare le discussioni del consiglio di crescita e garantire decisioni traducono in azioni chiare e risultati misurabili.
Generare informazioni strategiche e finanziarie

• Analizzare le dinamiche di mercato, i driver di crescita e le opportunità di investimento per informare la strategia aziendale.
• Sviluppare previsioni a lungo termine, scenari e casi di business che guidano scelte strategiche.
• Tradurre analisi complesse in raccomandazioni chiare e attuabili per la leadership senior.
Il tuo sfondo
Sei un professionista di strategia analitica, strutturata e collaborativa che è comodo lavorare con ambiguità e coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior sulle scelte a livello aziendale. In particolare, si offre:

• Laurea in Business Administration, economia, ingegneria, finanza o un campo correlato; un grado avanzato come un MBA è un plus.
• Esperienza rilevante in strategia, vendita e marketing, consulenza di gestione, sviluppo aziendale, finanza o pianificazione strategica in un ambiente internazionale.
• Forte capacità di modellazione analitica e finanziaria, con la capacità di sviluppare scenari, valutare opportunità e tradurre i dati in raccomandazioni attuabili.
• Esperienza nella preparazione di materiali a livello esecutivo, facilitando incontri senior e gestendo il follow-up delle azioni su più stakeholder.
• Capacità di lavorare in unità aziendali, regioni e funzioni con una mentalità One Hitachi Energy e una forte proprietà per i risultati.
• Curiosità circa la transizione energetica, i mercati di crescita, i cambiamenti tecnologici e le scelte strategiche necessarie per ispirare la prossima era di energia sostenibile.
• Passione per allenare i membri del team e costruire capacità di strategia sviluppando strumenti comuni, metodologie, modelli e modi di lavorare in tutta la comunità di strategia.
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione nella posizione specificata è il seguente:

• Italia: a partire da 86,000 EUR (Dirigente)
L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne.
Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva.
​
La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include:

• Competitività e incentivi
• Benessere e cura
• congedo pagato e non pagato
• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance
Gestalten Sie die Unternehmensstrategie von Hitachi Energy und fördern Sie Wachstumsentscheidungen!
Sind Sie bereit, die strategische Ausrichtung von Hitachi Energy auf Unternehmensebene zu definieren und in fokussierte Wachstumsprioritäten umzusetzen?
In unserer Strategiefunktion suchen wir nach einer Leader-Unternehmensstrategie, die die gesamte Hitachi Energy-Strategieformulierung unterstützen, strategische Prozesse entwerfen und verbessern, das integrierte Wachstumsportfolio strukturieren und vorantreiben und Führungskräften helfen kann, Chancen auf der Grundlage strategischer Attraktivität, finanzieller Auswirkungen und Ausführungsbereitschaft zu priorisieren.

Diese Position bietet einen flexiblen europäischen Standort und kann in Italien, Deutschland, Spanien, Großbritannien oder der Schweiz ansässig sein.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen
Gestaltung der zukünftigen Wachstumsagenda von Hitachi Energy

• Übersetzen Sie Markt-, Kunden-, Technologie- und Finanzinformationen in strategische Prioritäten, die das langfristige Wachstum vorantreiben.
• Identifizieren Sie aufkommende Trends, neue Wachstumschancen und strategische Risiken über Märkte und Geschäftsmodelle hinweg.
• Entwicklung von Empfehlungen und Szenarien auf Führungsebene zur Unterstützung wichtiger Wachstums- und Investitionsentscheidungen.
• Förderung der Ausrichtung auf Unternehmen, Regionen, Funktionen und die breitere Strategiegemeinschaft, einschließlich der Zusammenarbeit mit der Hitachi Group.
Steuerung des Unternehmenswachstums

• Gestalten und verwalten Sie das Wachstumsportfolio und bieten Sie Transparenz über strategische Möglichkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen.
• Support Growth Board Priorisierungs- und Investitionsentscheidungen basierend auf Wert, strategischer Anpassung und Durchführbarkeit.
• Bereiten und erleichtern Sie die Diskussionen des Growth Board und stellen Sie sicher, dass Entscheidungen in klare Maßnahmen und messbare Ergebnisse umgesetzt werden.
Generieren Sie strategische und finanzielle Einblicke

• Analysieren Sie die Marktdynamik, Wachstumstreiber und Investitionsmöglichkeiten, um die Unternehmensstrategie zu informieren.
• Entwickeln Sie langfristige Prognosen, Szenarien und Geschäftsfälle, die strategische Entscheidungen leiten.
• Übersetzen Sie komplexe Analysen in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen für Führungskräfte.
Dein Hintergrund
Sie sind ein analytischer, strukturierter und kollaborativer Strategieprofi, der sich wohl fühlt, mit Mehrdeutigkeiten zu arbeiten und hochrangige Stakeholder bei Entscheidungen auf Unternehmensebene zu engagieren. Konkret bieten Sie an:

• Universitätsabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich; ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss wie ein MBA ist ein Plus.
• Relevante Erfahrung in Strategie, Vertrieb & Marketing, Managementberatung, Unternehmensentwicklung, Finanzen oder strategischer Planung im internationalen Umfeld.
• Starke analytische und finanzielle Modellierungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Szenarien zu entwickeln, Chancen zu bewerten und Daten in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen.
• Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung von Materialien auf Führungsebene, der Erleichterung von Meetings auf Führungsebene und der Verwaltung von Folgemaßnahmen für mehrere Interessengruppen.
• Fähigkeit, über Geschäftseinheiten, Regionen und Funktionen hinweg mit einer One Hitachi Energy Denkweise und einer starken Eigenverantwortung für Ergebnisse zu arbeiten.
• Neugier auf die Energiewende, Wachstumsmärkte, Technologieverschiebungen und die strategischen Entscheidungen, die erforderlich sind, um die nächste Ära der nachhaltigen Energie zu inspirieren.
• Leidenschaft für das Coaching von Teammitgliedern und den Aufbau von Strategiefähigkeiten durch die Entwicklung gemeinsamer Tools, Methoden, Vorlagen und Arbeitsweisen in der gesamten Strategiegemeinschaft.
Mehr über uns
Das Mindestgehalt für diese Position an dem angegebenen Ort ist wie folgt:

• Italien: ab 86.000 EUR (Dirigente)
Das endgültige Angebot wird auf dem Standort, den Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen der Kandidaten, der Erfahrung und den internen Vergütungsstrukturen basieren.
Diese Rolle kann an mehreren Standorten offen sein. Wenn die angegebenen Gehaltsinformationen für Ihren aktuellen Standort nicht gelten, werden die für Ihren Standort relevanten Gehaltsdetails zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt mit Ihnen besprochen.
​
Unser Leistungsangebot ist auf Ihr Beschäftigungsland zugeschnitten und umfasst in der Regel:

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und Anreize
• Wohlbefinden und Pflege
• Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub
• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen
• Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen Sie erhalten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses spezifischere Informationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
Formez la stratégie d'entreprise d'Hitachi Energy et stimulez les choix de croissance !
Êtes-vous prêt à aider à définir l'orientation stratégique d'Hitachi Energy au niveau de l'entreprise et à la traduire en priorités de croissance ciblées?
Dans le cadre de notre fonction Stratégie, nous cherchons une stratégie d'entreprise leader qui peut appuyer la formulation, la conception et l'amélioration des processus stratégiques, structurer et piloter le portefeuille de croissance intégré, et aider les dirigeants supérieurs à prioriser les occasions en fonction de l'attractivité stratégique, de l'impact financier et de la préparation à l'exécution.

Cette position offre un emplacement européen flexible et peut être basée en Italie, en Allemagne, en Espagne, au Royaume-Uni ou en Suisse.

Comment vous ferez un impact
Forme Programme de croissance futur d'Hitachi Energy

• Traduire le marché, les clients, la technologie et les perspectives financières en priorités stratégiques qui stimulent la croissance à long terme.
• Identifier les nouvelles tendances, les nouvelles possibilités de croissance et les risques stratégiques sur les marchés et les modèles d'affaires.
• Élaborer des recommandations et des scénarios au niveau de la direction pour appuyer les principales décisions en matière de croissance et d'investissement.
• Favoriser l'harmonisation entre les entreprises, les régions, les fonctions et la communauté stratégique, y compris la collaboration avec le groupe Hitachi.
Favoriser la gouvernance de la croissance des entreprises

• Former et gérer le portefeuille de croissance, en offrant une visibilité des possibilités stratégiques dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Appuyer les décisions de priorité et d'investissement du Conseil de croissance en fonction de la valeur, de l'ajustement stratégique et de la faisabilité de l'exécution.
• Préparer et faciliter les discussions du conseil de croissance et veiller à ce que les décisions se traduisent par des mesures claires et des résultats mesurables.
Générer des perspectives stratégiques et financières

• Analyser la dynamique du marché, les facteurs de croissance et les possibilités d'investissement pour éclairer la stratégie d'entreprise.
• Élaborer des prévisions à long terme, des scénarios et des analyses de rentabilisation qui guident les choix stratégiques.
• Traduire l'analyse complexe en recommandations claires et réalisables pour les cadres supérieurs.
Vos antécédents
Vous êtes un professionnel de la stratégie analytique, structurée et collaborative qui est à l'aise de travailler avec l'ambiguïté et d'engager les intervenants seniors sur les choix au niveau de l'entreprise. Plus précisément, vous offrez :

• Diplôme universitaire en administration des affaires, économie, génie, finances ou un domaine connexe; un diplôme avancé comme un MBA est un plus.
• Expérience pertinente en stratégie, vente et marketing, conseil en gestion, développement d'entreprise, finances ou planification stratégique dans un environnement international.
• De solides compétences en modélisation analytique et financière, avec la capacité d'élaborer des scénarios, d'évaluer les possibilités et de traduire les données en recommandations concrètes.
• Expérience de la préparation de documents à l'échelle de la direction, de la facilitation des réunions de la haute direction et de la gestion du suivi de l'action entre plusieurs intervenants.
• Capacité de travailler à l'échelle des unités opérationnelles, des régions et des fonctions avec un état d'esprit One Hitachi Energy et une forte appropriation des résultats.
• Curiosité sur la transition énergétique, les marchés de croissance, les changements technologiques et les choix stratégiques nécessaires pour inspirer la prochaine ère de l'énergie durable.

jobs.title: Internship in Product Management & Marketing (Sales Campaign Launch) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about technology, strategy, and business growth? Join our Product Management & Marketing team and help turn market opportunities into impactful customer campaigns and scalable growth initiatives. Working closely with the Service Campaign Manager, you will gain hands-on experience in campaign management, sales enablement, commercial operations, and performance tracking across global markets. Collaborate with experienced professionals, build a strong network, and contribute to projects that drive real business results. The internship lasts 6 months, with the possibility to align your Master's thesis with relevant company projects.

How you'll make an impact

• Design, launch and execute global service campaigns
• Develop sales enablement material, campaign playbooks and customer communication packages
• Analyze installed base, customer, and campaign data to support prioritization and decision-making
• Track campaign performance and maintain KPI dashboards using Excel and Power BI
• Contribute to the standardization of campaign processes, tools, and best practices
• Work closely together with Product Management, Sales, Marketing, and Service teams
• Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, gaining exposure to senior leadership
Your background

• Currently enrolled in a master's program in management, technology, economics, engineering, or a related field
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data-driven decision making
• Exposure to strategic management, marketing analytics through coursework or projects
• Comfortable working with data and translating insights into business recommendations
• Proactive, structured, and comfortable working across functions and cultures
• Excellent communication skills in English; German is a plus
More about us

We are a technology‑oriented company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated support, and a supportive, inclusive environment in which you can develop both personally and professionally. jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (80-100%) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
As Area Sales Manager, you will drive market penetration and profitable growth for our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) Service portfolio. You'll lead and empower local sales teams, foster customer relationships, and leverage on digital tools to deliver exceptional service and results.

Our Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of GCB and GIS systems for both Transmission (220kV-550kV) and Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV) level, including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, value-added services, troubleshooting, modification, retrofits and replacements.

You have a higher education with a technical and/or commercial focus? You have profound sales experience and service mindset with strong negotiation skills? You are highly experienced in working closely together with customers from different countries, you understand their requirements and you can handle any complaints or issues? You have self-motivation and persistence as well as a service-mindset? Then we have the right opportunity for you!

How you'll make an impact

• Define and execute go-to-market strategies together with local service sales teams, channel partners, and service organizations to drive sustainable order growth
• Lead proactive sales and marketing activities for maintenance and service solutions while optimizing regional pricing strategies and increasing market penetration
• Analyze installed base data, market dynamics, and customer needs to develop sales action plans and grow the maintenance sales pipeline
• Build strong customer and partner relationships, provide consultative support, and enable local service sales teams through product and service knowledge sharing
• Manage the entire service project offer process, from opportunity identification and quotation preparation through contract negotiation and handover to execution
• Utilize digital tools, CRM systems, and sales analytics to ensure data quality, maintain accurate forecasts, and improve customer experience
• Monitor business performance against targets, identify gaps, develop annual order budgets, and implement actions to achieve growth objectives
• Mentor and support service sales teams at Product Service Center and Local Service Unit, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and drive enhancements of sales processes and tools
Your background

• Degree in a technical or commercial discipline
• Proven experience in sales, business development, or account management within the energy, industrial, or infrastructure sector
• Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with a track record of delivering results
• Customer-focused approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across diverse markets and cultures
• Experience with Salesforce, SAP, and other digital sales tools
• Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
• Self-motivated, resilient, and driven to create business opportunities
• Fluent in English; additional languages such as Spanish are a plus
• Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%
More about us

• You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement
• You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities
• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought
• Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all
• Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities
• A competitive compensation and benefits package
Hitachi Energy is able to offer you an interesting role within a highly motivated team, together with open communication structures. On the basis of a personal, practice-oriented introduction program, you will be given the opportunity to acquire the confidence needed to work independently as well as be a constructive member of an inclusive team within your assigned area. Hitachi Energy is also able to provide a wealth of opportunities for personal development once you have completed your introduction period, the aim being to assist you in attaining your career goals. Personalized development programs with targeted training measures will help you to enhance your skills on a continuous basis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Come Area Sales Manager, guiderai la penetrazione del mercato e la crescita redditizia per il nostro portafoglio di servizi Interruttore isolato a gas (GIS) e Interruttore a circuito di generatore (GCB). Potrai guidare e potenziare i team di vendita locali, promuovere le relazioni con i clienti e sfruttare gli strumenti digitali per fornire servizi e risultati eccezionali.

La nostra unità di servizio è responsabile per il supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi GCB e GIS sia per il livello Transmission (220kV-550kV) sia per il livello Sub-transmission (60kV-170kV), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi a valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, modifiche, retrofit e sostituzioni.

Hai una formazione superiore con un focus tecnico e/o commerciale? Hai un'esperienza di vendita profonda e una mentalità di servizio con forti capacità di negoziazione? Sei molto esperto nel lavorare a stretto contatto con i clienti di diversi paesi, capisci i loro requisiti e puoi gestire eventuali reclami o problemi? Avete auto-motivazione e persistenza così come un servizio-mindset? Allora abbiamo la giusta opportunità per voi!

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Definire ed eseguire strategie di go-to-market insieme a team di vendita di servizi locali, partner di canale e organizzazioni di servizi per guidare la crescita sostenibile dell'ordine
• Guidare attività proattive di vendita e marketing per le soluzioni di manutenzione e servizio, ottimizzando le strategie regionali di prezzi e aumentando la penetrazione del mercato
• Analizzare i dati di base installati, le dinamiche di mercato, e il cliente ha bisogno di sviluppare piani di azione di vendita e crescere la pipeline di vendita di manutenzione
• Costruire forti relazioni con i clienti e i partner, fornire supporto consultivo, e consentire ai team di vendita di servizi locali attraverso la condivisione delle conoscenze di prodotto e di servizio
• Gestire l'intero processo di offerta del progetto di servizio, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e dalla preparazione delle quotazioni attraverso la negoziazione dei contratti e la consegna all'esecuzione
• Utilizzare strumenti digitali, sistemi CRM e analisi delle vendite per garantire la qualità dei dati, mantenere previsioni accurate e migliorare l'esperienza del cliente
• Monitorare le prestazioni aziendali contro gli obiettivi, identificare le lacune, sviluppare i bilanci annuali di ordine e attuare azioni per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita
• Mentor e team di vendita di servizi di supporto presso il Product Service Center e l'unità di servizio locale, favoriscono una cultura del miglioramento continuo, e migliorano i processi di vendita e gli strumenti
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in una disciplina tecnica o commerciale
• Esperienza comprovata nel settore delle vendite, dello sviluppo aziendale o della gestione contabile nel settore energetico, industriale o infrastrutturale
• Forte acume commerciale e competenze di negoziazione con un track record di fornire risultati
• L'approccio focalizzato sul cliente e la capacità di costruire relazioni di fiducia in diversi mercati e culture
• Esperienza con Salesforce, SAP e altri strumenti di vendita digitali
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione degli stakeholder
• Automotivato, resiliente e guidato per creare opportunità di business
• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive come lo spagnolo sono un plus
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 50%
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

• Farete un lavoro interessante e arricchente come parte di un team dinamico, appassionato e collaborativo impegnato in innovazione e miglioramento continuo
• Sarete allungati, incoraggiati e sostenuti a crescere – siamo orgogliosi di fornire forti opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo
• Offriamo un ambiente che favorisce la collaborazione, la connessione e la diversità del pensiero
• La nostra cultura è uno dei tipi: venite come siete e portate i vostri attributi unici, la passione e spingete alla progettazione e alla gestione di Pensioni & Benefici a Hitachi Energy, contribuendo a farci “il posto dove essere” e al nostro scopo di promuovere un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti
• Lavoro flessibile, comprese le opportunità di lavoro ibride/remote
• Un pacchetto di compensazione e benefici competitivi
Hitachi Energy è in grado di offrire un ruolo interessante all'interno di un team altamente motivato, insieme a strutture di comunicazione aperte. Sulla base di un programma di introduzione personale, orientato alla pratica, ti verrà data l'opportunità di acquisire la fiducia necessaria per lavorare in modo indipendente e di essere un membro costruttivo di un team inclusivo all'interno della tua area assegnata. Hitachi Energy è anche in grado di fornire una ricchezza di opportunità per lo sviluppo personale una volta completato il periodo di introduzione, l'obiettivo è quello di aiutarvi a raggiungere i vostri obiettivi di carriera. Programmi di sviluppo personalizzati con misure di formazione mirate vi aiuterà a migliorare le vostre abilità su base continua.

Sie haben Selbstmotivation und Ausdauer sowie ein Service-Mindset? Dann haben wir die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie!

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Definieren und implementieren Sie Go-to-Market-Strategien zusammen mit lokalen Service-Vertriebsteams, Channel-Partnern und Serviceorganisationen, um ein nachhaltiges Auftragswachstum zu fördern

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
En tant que responsable des ventes sur place, vous favoriserez la pénétration du marché et la croissance rentable de notre portefeuille de services de commutateurs à gaz isolants (GIS) et de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB). Vous dirigerez et responsabiliserez les équipes de vente locales, favoriserez les relations avec la clientèle et tirerez parti des outils numériques pour offrir un service et des résultats exceptionnels.

Notre unité de service est responsable du support après-vente mondial des systèmes GCB et SIG pour transmission (220kV-550kV) et sous-transmission (60kV-170kV), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien programmé, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, la modification, les rénovations et les remplacements.

Vous avez un enseignement supérieur avec une orientation technique et/ou commerciale? Vous avez une expérience de vente profonde et un état d'esprit de service avec de solides compétences en négociation? Vous êtes très expérimenté dans la collaboration étroite avec des clients de différents pays, vous comprenez leurs exigences et vous pouvez traiter des plaintes ou des problèmes? Vous avez de l'automotivation et de la persévérance ainsi qu'un service-mindset? Alors nous avons la bonne opportunité pour vous!

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Définir et exécuter des stratégies d'accès au marché en collaboration avec les équipes de vente de services locaux, les partenaires des canaux et les organismes de services pour stimuler la croissance durable des commandes
• Diriger des activités de vente et de commercialisation proactives pour les solutions de maintenance et de service tout en optimisant les stratégies régionales de tarification et en augmentant la pénétration du marché
• Analyser les données de base installées, la dynamique du marché et les besoins des clients pour élaborer des plans d'action sur les ventes et développer le pipeline de vente de maintenance
• Établir de solides relations avec les clients et les partenaires, fournir un soutien consultatif et permettre aux équipes de vente de services locaux de partager leurs connaissances sur les produits et les services
• Gérer l'ensemble du processus d'offre du projet de service, de l'identification des opportunités et de la préparation des devis à la négociation du contrat et au transfert à l'exécution
• Utiliser des outils numériques, des systèmes CRM et des analyses de ventes pour assurer la qualité des données, maintenir des prévisions précises et améliorer l'expérience client
• Surveiller le rendement des entreprises par rapport aux cibles, cerner les lacunes, élaborer des budgets d'ordre annuel et mettre en oeuvre des mesures pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance
• Mentor et équipes de vente de services de soutien au Centre de services de produits et au Service local, favoriser une culture d'amélioration continue et stimuler l'amélioration des processus et des outils de vente
Vos antécédents

• Diplôme dans une discipline technique ou commerciale
• Expérience éprouvée en matière de vente, de développement d'entreprise ou de gestion de compte dans le secteur de l'énergie, de l'industrie ou des infrastructures
• Fortes compétences en matière de négociation et d'exercice de l'activité commerciale, avec des résultats déjà obtenus
• Une approche axée sur le client et la capacité d'établir des relations de confiance entre différents marchés et cultures
• Expérience avec Salesforce, SAP et autres outils de vente numériques
• Fortes compétences en communication, présentation et gestion des intervenants
• Automotivé, résilient et poussé à créer des débouchés commerciaux
• Fluent en anglais; d'autres langues comme l'espagnol sont un plus
• Volonté de voyager à l'étranger jusqu'à 50%
Plus sur nous

• Vous ferez un travail intéressant et enrichissant dans le cadre d'une équipe dynamique, passionnée et collaborative engagée dans l'innovation et l'amélioration continue
• Vous serez tendus, encouragés et soutenus pour grandir – nous sommes fiers de fournir de fortes possibilités d'apprentissage et de développement
• Nous offrons un environnement qui favorise la collaboration, la connexion et la diversité de pensée
• Notre culture est unique : venez comme vous êtes et apportez vos attributs uniques, votre passion et votre dynamisme à la conception et à la gestion de Pensions & Avantages chez Hitachi Energy, contribuant à faire de nous l'endroit où être et à notre objectif de faire progresser un avenir énergétique durable pour tous
• Possibilités de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybrides/à distance
• Une rémunération et des avantages concurrentiels
Hitachi Energy est en mesure de vous offrir un rôle intéressant au sein d'une équipe très motivée, ainsi que des structures de communication ouvertes. Hitachi Energy est également en mesure de fournir une multitude de possibilités de développement personnel une fois que vous avez terminé votre période d'introduction, le but étant de vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs de carrière. Des programmes de perfectionnement personnalisés avec des mesures de formation ciblées vous aideront à améliorer vos compétences de façon continue.

jobs.title: Project Manager Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager Engineering or Lead Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead and manage converter system projects from sales/tender phase to initiation and through to completion, ensuring Engineering deliverables are on time, within budget, and in line with quality requirements.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in Engineering within defined timelines and budgets

• Lead the technical solution development during sales and tender phase for Engineering.

• Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in close collaboration with stakeholders

• Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth project execution

• Communicate project plans, progress, and expectations clearly and proactively

• Assess resource requirements and ensure effective allocation throughout the project lifecycle

• Track Engineering project milestones, timelines, and deliverables using appropriate tools

• Identify technical risks early, manage changes in scope, and implement suitable mitigation measures

• Lead, coach, and motivate project team members, fostering accountability and high performance

• Conduct project reviews and capture key learnings, deriving actionable recommendations for future improvements

Your background

• Master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering

• Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution within an engineering environment

• Experience with power systems and converter systems is a plus

• Proven track record in managing complex engineering projects

• PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage

• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in English is required; German is a plus

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
