descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
A Hitachi Energy, il nostro scopo sta avanzando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Portiamo il potere nelle nostre case, scuole, ospedali e fabbriche. Unisciti a noi e lavorare con persone fantastiche, imparando e sviluppandosi su progetti che hanno un impatto reale per le nostre comunità e la società. Porta la tua passione, porta la tua energia e fai parte di un team globale che apprezza una semplice verità: diversità + collaborazione = grande innovazione.

In qualità di Global Casting Process Definition & Improvement Specialist presso HITACHI ENERGY LTD, sarai responsabile della definizione, dell'ottimizzazione e del miglioramento dei processi e delle attrezzature di Casting nelle nostre operazioni globali. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla guida dell'efficienza, sulla standardizzazione delle migliori pratiche e sull'implementazione di soluzioni innovative per migliorare la produttività e la qualità dei prodotti.

Come farete un impatto:

• Guidare lo sviluppo e la documentazione di processi e attrezzature di fusione standardizzati, istruzioni di lavoro e le migliori pratiche in vari siti di produzione a livello globale.

• Analizzare i processi di fusione esistenti per identificare i colli di bottiglia, le inefficienze e le aree di miglioramento utilizzando la produzione magra e le metodologie Six Sigma.

• Progettare e implementare i miglioramenti dei processi e delle attrezzature, comprese le nuove tecnologie, soluzioni di automazione e flussi di lavoro operativi, per ottimizzare la produzione, ridurre i costi e migliorare la qualità.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali, tra cui R&D, ingegneria, qualità e produzione, per garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità di nuovi processi, attrezzature e tecnologie. Sviluppare e fornire programmi di formazione per il personale di produzione su nuovi e migliori processi e strumenti.

• Monitorare e analizzare gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) relativi ai processi di casting, identificare le tendenze e raccomandare azioni correttive. Condurre audit e valutazioni di processo per garantire il rispetto degli standard definiti e identificare le opportunità di miglioramento continuo.

• Sostenere l'implementazione di iniziative di produzione digitale e tecnologie Industry 4.0. Rimani al passo con le migliori pratiche del settore, le nuove tecnologie e i requisiti normativi relativi ai processi di casting.

• Gestire progetti complessi relativi al miglioramento del processo e delle attrezzature, garantendo il completamento tempestivo e l'adesione al bilancio.

• Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative esterne e interne applicabili, procedure e linee guida.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Ingegneria (Chemical, Meccanico, Elettrico, Industriale, o Manufacturing preferito) o un campo tecnico correlato. La laurea magistrale e' un vantaggio.

• Forte anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi di fusione, nel miglioramento dei processi o in un ruolo simile all'interno di un ambiente di produzione globale.

• Testimonianza comprovata di implementare con successo i miglioramenti del processo e di guidare l'eccellenza operativa &Strong conoscenza dei principi di produzione magra, metodologie Six Sigma (Green Belt o Black Belt certificazione preferita), e altri strumenti di miglioramento continuo.

• Esperienza con sistemi di esecuzione di produzione (MES), sistemi di pianificazione delle risorse aziendali (ERP) e altri software di produzione rilevanti. La competenza nella mappatura del processo, nella mappatura del flusso di valore e in altre tecniche di analisi del processo.

• Eccellente gestione del progetto, analitica, problem solving, decision-making, comunicazione, presentazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di condurre iniziative complesse e influenzare efficacemente gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi.

• Capacità di viaggiare a livello internazionale come richiesto a vari siti di produzione.

• È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; la competenza in altre lingue è un vantaggio.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Siamo orgogliosi di offrire una gamma olistica di vantaggi competitivi per sostenere il vostro benessere finanziario, fisico e mentale, così come la vostra crescita professionale. Vogliamo che tu prosperi veramente con noi, nel lavoro e fuori.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance
Bei Hitachi Energy ist es unser Ziel, eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle voranzutreiben. Wir bringen Energie in unsere Häuser, Schulen, Krankenhäuser und Fabriken. Begleiten Sie uns und arbeiten Sie mit fantastischen Menschen zusammen, während Sie lernen und sich an Projekten entwickeln, die einen echten Einfluss auf unsere Gemeinschaften und die Gesellschaft haben. Bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft ein, bringen Sie Ihre Energie ein und werden Sie Teil eines globalen Teams, das eine einfache Wahrheit schätzt: Vielfalt + Zusammenarbeit = Große Innovation.

Als Global Casting Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD sind Sie für die Definition, Optimierung und Verbesserung von Gießprozessen und -anlagen in unseren globalen Betrieben verantwortlich. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Steigerung der Effizienz, die Standardisierung von Best Practices und die Implementierung innovativer Lösungen zur Steigerung der Produktivität und Produktqualität.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen:

• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Dokumentation von standardisierten Gießprozessen und -anlagen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Best Practices an verschiedenen Produktionsstandorten weltweit.

• Analysieren Sie bestehende Gussverfahren, um Engpässe, Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsbereiche mithilfe von Lean Manufacturing und Six Sigma-Methoden zu identifizieren.

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie Prozess- und Ausrüstungsverbesserungen, einschließlich neuer Technologien, Automatisierungslösungen und operativer Workflows, um die Produktionsleistung zu optimieren, Kosten zu senken und die Qualität zu verbessern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, einschließlich F & E, Engineering, Qualität und Produktion, um eine nahtlose Integration neuer Prozesse, Ausrüstung und Technologien zu gewährleisten. Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Schulungsprogrammen für Fertigungspersonal zu neuen und verbesserten Prozessen und Werkzeugen.

• Überwachen und analysieren Sie Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in Bezug auf Gießprozesse, identifizieren Sie Trends und empfehlen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen. Durchführung von Prozessaudits und -bewertungen, um die Einhaltung definierter Standards sicherzustellen und Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu identifizieren.

• Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung digitaler Fertigungsinitiativen und Industrie 4.0-Technologien. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Best Practices, neue Technologien und regulatorische Anforderungen in Bezug auf Gussverfahren.

• Verwalten Sie komplexe Projekte im Zusammenhang mit Prozess- und Ausrüstungsverbesserungen, um eine rechtzeitige Fertigstellung und Einhaltung des Budgets zu gewährleisten.

• Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien.

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial oder Manufacturing Preferred) oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. Der Master ist ein Plus.

• Starke jahrelange Erfahrung in der Gießtechnik, Prozessverbesserung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer globalen Fertigungsumgebung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der erfolgreichen Implementierung von Prozessverbesserungen und der Förderung operativer Exzellenz & Starkes Wissen über Lean-Fertigungsprinzipien, Six-Sigma-Methoden (Green Belt- oder Black Belt-Zertifizierung bevorzugt) und andere Tools zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

• Erfahrung mit Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systemen und anderer relevanter Fertigungssoftware. Kenntnisse in Process Mapping, Value Stream Mapping und anderen Prozessanalysetechniken.

• Exzellentes Projektmanagement, Analyse, Problemlösung, Entscheidungsfindung, Kommunikation, Präsentation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Initiativen zu leiten und Stakeholder auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen effektiv zu beeinflussen.

• Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf international zu verschiedenen Produktionsstätten zu reisen.

• Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Kenntnisse in anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Mehr über uns
Wir sind stolz darauf, eine ganzheitliche Palette von Wettbewerbsvorteilen anzubieten, um Ihr finanzielles, körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden sowie Ihr berufliches Wachstum zu unterstützen. Wir möchten, dass Sie mit uns wirklich gedeihen, in der Arbeit und draußen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
Chez Hitachi Energy, notre objectif est de promouvoir un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Nous apportons le pouvoir à nos maisons, écoles, hôpitaux et usines. Rejoignez-nous et travaillez avec des gens fantastiques, tout en apprenant et en vous développant sur des projets qui ont un impact réel sur nos communautés et notre société. Apportez votre passion, apportez votre énergie et faites partie d'une équipe mondiale qui apprécie une simple vérité : Diversité + Collaboration = Grande Innovation.

En tant que spécialiste de la définition et de l'amélioration des processus de coulée à l'échelle mondiale chez HITACHI ENERGY LTD, vous serez responsable de la définition, de l'optimisation et de l'amélioration des processus et des équipements de coulée à l'échelle mondiale. Ce rôle est axé sur l'efficacité, la normalisation des meilleures pratiques et la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes pour améliorer la productivité et la qualité des produits.

Comment vous ferez un impact:

• Diriger l'élaboration et la documentation de processus et d'équipement de coulée normalisés, d'instructions de travail et de pratiques exemplaires dans divers sites de production à l'échelle mondiale.

• Analyser les processus de coulée existants afin d'identifier les goulets d'étranglement, les inefficacités et les domaines d'amélioration à l'aide des méthodes de fabrication maigre et de Six Sigma.

• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations de processus et d'équipement, y compris les nouvelles technologies, les solutions d'automatisation et les flux de travail opérationnels, pour optimiser la production, réduire les coûts et améliorer la qualité.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, y compris la R-D, l'ingénierie, la qualité et la production, afin d'assurer une intégration transparente des nouveaux processus, équipements et technologies. Élaborer et offrir des programmes de formation à l'intention du personnel de fabrication sur les procédés et les outils nouveaux et améliorés.

• Surveiller et analyser les principaux indicateurs de rendement liés aux processus de coulée, cerner les tendances et recommander des mesures correctives. Effectuer des vérifications et des évaluations des processus afin d'assurer la conformité aux normes établies et de déterminer les possibilités d'amélioration continue.

• Soutenir la mise en œuvre d'initiatives de fabrication numérique et de technologies Industrie 4.0. Restez au courant des pratiques exemplaires de l'industrie, des nouvelles technologies et des exigences réglementaires liées aux procédés de coulée.

• Gérer les projets complexes liés à l'amélioration des processus et de l'équipement, en veillant à ce que le budget soit terminé en temps opportun et respecté.

• Responsable de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables.

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en génie (choix chimique, mécanique, électrique, industriel ou manufacturier) ou un domaine technique connexe. La maîtrise est un plus.

• Fortes années d'expérience dans l'ingénierie des procédés de coulée, l'amélioration des procédés ou un rôle similaire dans un environnement de fabrication mondial.

• Expérience éprouvée de la mise en oeuvre réussie des améliorations des processus et de l'excellence opérationnelle et connaissance approfondie des principes de fabrication maigre, des méthodes Six Sigma (certification de ceinture verte ou de ceinture noire préférée) et d'autres outils d'amélioration continue.

• Expérience des systèmes d'exécution de la fabrication (MES), du progiciel de gestion intégré (PGI) et d'autres logiciels de fabrication pertinents. Connaissance de la cartographie des processus, de la cartographie des flux de valeurs et d'autres techniques d'analyse des processus.

• Excellente gestion de projet, analyse, résolution de problèmes, prise de décisions, communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de diriger des initiatives complexes et d'influencer efficacement les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels.

• Capacité de voyager à l'étranger selon les besoins dans divers sites de fabrication.

• La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise; la maîtrise d'autres langues est un plus.

Plus sur nous
Nous sommes fiers d'offrir une gamme globale d'avantages concurrentiels pour soutenir votre bien-être financier, physique et mental, ainsi que votre croissance professionnelle. Nous voulons que vous prospérez vraiment avec nous, dans le travail et dehors.

jobs.title: Sales and Operations Planning Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about shaping business performance through strategic planning and cross-functional collaboration? Join Hitachi Energy and take a leading role in driving our global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. In this highly visible position, you will work closely with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment between market demand, operational capabilities, and business objectives. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are motivated to make a measurable impact, we would love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead and continuously improve Hitachi Energy's local Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives

• Facilitate monthly S&OP reviews and executive meetings, providing insights, reports, and recommendations to support decision-making

• Collaborate with Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Product Management to drive alignment, resolve conflicts, and build consensus

• Develop demand planning and forecasting methodologies for a broad portfolio of critical products, leveraging market intelligence and data analytics

• Monitor key performance indicators such as forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory performance, and production adherence to drive business improvements

• Lead and support strategic initiatives, representing the planning organization in cross-functional and continuous improvement programs

• Drive process optimization through digital solutions, analytics, and best practices to enhance planning excellence

• Present executive-level analyses and recommendations while mentoring team members and fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree is an advantage . APICS CPIM or CSCP certification is an advantage;

• Significant experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, or S&OP within an international manufacturing environment

• Advanced SAP knowledge; experience with intercompany purchasing and planning is highly desirable

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into business decisions

• Proven ability to work independently, manage a high workload, solve complex problems, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment

• Strong communication, presentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior management and cross-functional teams

• GIS products and business structure knowledge is beneficial

• Highly motivated, precise, and proactive professional with a continuous improvement mindset;

• Business fluent in English, German is beneficial

Why you'll succeed

You are a precise and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning data into business value. You combine strong planning expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and can confidently engage with senior leaders. Your independent working style, resilience, and motivation enable you to deliver results in a fast-paced environment while driving continuous improvement and collaboration across the organization.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about shaping business performance through strategic planning and cross-functional collaboration? Join Hitachi Energy and take a leading role in driving our global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. In this highly visible position, you will work closely with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment between market demand, operational capabilities, and business objectives. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are motivated to make a measurable impact, we would love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead and continuously improve Hitachi Energy's local Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives

• Facilitate monthly S&OP reviews and executive meetings, providing insights, reports, and recommendations to support decision-making

• Collaborate with Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Product Management to drive alignment, resolve conflicts, and build consensus

• Develop demand planning and forecasting methodologies for a broad portfolio of critical products, leveraging market intelligence and data analytics

• Monitor key performance indicators such as forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory performance, and production adherence to drive business improvements

• Lead and support strategic initiatives, representing the planning organization in cross-functional and continuous improvement programs

• Drive process optimization through digital solutions, analytics, and best practices to enhance planning excellence

• Present executive-level analyses and recommendations while mentoring team members and fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree is an advantage . APICS CPIM or CSCP certification is an advantage;

• Significant experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, or S&OP within an international manufacturing environment

• Advanced SAP knowledge; experience with intercompany purchasing and planning is highly desirable

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into business decisions

• Proven ability to work independently, manage a high workload, solve complex problems, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment

• Strong communication, presentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior management and cross-functional teams

• GIS products and business structure knowledge is beneficial

• Highly motivated, precise, and proactive professional with a continuous improvement mindset;

• Business fluent in English, German is beneficial

Why you'll succeed

You are a precise and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning data into business value. You combine strong planning expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and can confidently engage with senior leaders. Your independent working style, resilience, and motivation enable you to deliver results in a fast-paced environment while driving continuous improvement and collaboration across the organization.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: R&D Design Engineer - Insulation and Components Global Product Care
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability.

How you will make an impact

• You will establish mechanical simulation models for transformer components such as bushings, tap-changers and measurement devices, conduct static/dynamic mechanics, model, seismic, short-circuit impact and thermal-structure coupling simulation analysis.
• You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international & domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product R&D, type test and mass production.
• You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new R&D solution.
• You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
• Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components.
• Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes.
• Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality.
• Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team
Your background

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components
• Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
• Should have good understanding of IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM Standards.
• Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
• Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership.
• Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement.
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

• Company events and team‑building activities​

Collaborerai con team funzionali e fabbriche cross a livello globale per garantire che le specifiche del progetto vengano soddisfatte rispettando gli standard del settore e le migliori pratiche di progettazione. La vostra esperienza nei principi e nelle pratiche ingegneristiche contribuirà ad ottimizzare i progetti per prestazioni, funzionalità e sostenibilità.

Come si farà un impatto

• Istituirai modelli di simulazione meccanica per i componenti del trasformatore come boccole, scambiatori di rubinetti e dispositivi di misura, conduci meccanica statica/dinamica, modello, impatto sismico, cortocircuito e analisi di simulazione di accoppiamento termico-struttura.
• Condurrà la verifica delle prestazioni meccaniche in conformità con IEC, IEEE, GB e altri standard internazionali e nazionali, emettere rapporti di simulazione professionale, fornire supporto tecnico per il prodotto R&D, test di tipo e produzione di massa.
• Continuerai a sviluppare strumenti interni per le valutazioni meccaniche, partecipare a scambi tecnici industriali. Supporta i problemi delle fabbriche nel tuo dominio di competenze e collabora con il team globale per la valutazione della nuova soluzione R&D.
• L'utente sarà responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili.
• Collabora con il team della supply chain per garantire che i progetti siano manufacturable e convenienti, selezionando materiali e componenti ottimali.
• Valuta e seleziona materiali e processi produttivi appropriati.
• Condurre approfondite recensioni e verifiche di progettazione, implementando modifiche per elevare la qualità del progetto.
• Prendere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno di team di progetto, mentre sostenere e mentoring colleghi junior
• Agire come esperto di materia, sostenere i colleghi e condividere le conoscenze per promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione all'interno del team
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato
• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in attrezzature o componenti ad alta tensione
• Solida conoscenza meccanica, idealmente nel campo degli isolatori elettrici o componenti ad alta tensione
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, scritto e parlato
• Dovrebbe avere una buona comprensione degli standard IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM.
• Esperienza nell'analisi degli elementi finiti e nell'uso del software ANSYS
• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze.
• Capacità di parlare e lavorare insieme con i team tecnici in diverse parti del mondo.
• Atteggiamento attivo, auto-motivato e con un forte senso di proprietà.
• Aperto a cambiamento, feedback e miglioramento continuo.
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability.

How you will make an impact

• You will establish mechanical simulation models for transformer components such as bushings, tap-changers and measurement devices, conduct static/dynamic mechanics, model, seismic, short-circuit impact and thermal-structure coupling simulation analysis.
• You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international & domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product R&D, type test and mass production.
• You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new R&D solution.
• You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
• Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components.
• Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes.
• Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality.
• Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team
Your background

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components
• Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
• Should have good understanding of IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM Standards.
• Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
• Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership.
• Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement.
More about us

jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers.
The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations.

How you'll make an impact

• Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations

• Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies

• Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues

• Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions

• Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities

• Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases

• Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency

• Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities

Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing

• Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent)

• Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment

• Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues

• Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent

More about us

We offer you:

• Extra days off between Christmas and New Year

• Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens

• 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges

• Discount on memberships at various fitness centres

• Discounts on various products and services

• Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund

• Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Bei Hitachi Energy haben Sie die Möglichkeit, komplexe und sinnvolle GIS-Projekte zu leiten, die die Energiewende auf der ganzen Welt unterstützen. Als Projektmanager arbeiten Sie mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams, Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern, die eine echte Wirkung erzielen.

Wir suchen eine kollaborative und proaktive Führungskraft, die es genießt, Menschen zusammenzubringen, Herausforderungen zu lösen und erfolgreiche Projektergebnisse voranzutreiben. Ob Ihre Erfahrung aus GIS, Umspannwerken, Strominfrastruktur oder einer verwandten industriellen Umgebung stammt, wir empfehlen Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir schätzen vielfältige Perspektiven, Führungspotenziale und eine Wachstumsmentalität ebenso wie spezifische Branchenerfahrung.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Führen Sie komplexe internationale Projekte während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus, von der Projektübergabe über Engineering, Fertigung, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Endlieferung

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Projektausführung und stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte sicher, pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und nach höchsten Qualitätsstandards geliefert werden

• Bauen Sie vertrauenswürdige Partnerschaften mit Kunden auf und dienen Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner während der gesamten Projektabwicklung

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären Teams in den Bereichen Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain und Service weltweit

• Pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern, um die Ausrichtung und den Projekterfolg zu fördern

• Identifizieren Sie proaktiv Risiken, Chancen und Verbesserungsinitiativen und führen Sie das Team durch Herausforderungen und Veränderungen

• Verwalten Sie kommerzielle Aspekte von Projekten, einschließlich Verträgen, Ansprüchen, Prognosen und finanzieller Leistung

• Unterstützung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsbemühungen und Beitrag zum Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und zur Entwicklung von Projektmanagement-Exzellenz innerhalb der Organisation

Dein Hintergrund

• Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung komplexer internationaler Projekte in einem globalen industriellen Umfeld

• Erfahrung in GIS, Umspannwerken, Energieübertragung, Energieinfrastruktur oder ähnlichen Branchen wird hoch geschätzt

• In der Lage sein, die Projektabwicklung, das Stakeholder-Management und die Kundenbindung voranzutreiben

• Geschäfts- und Finanzsinn mit Erfahrung im Management von Budgets, Zeitplänen, Risiken und Verträgen

• Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu leiten und erfolgreich in komplexen, multikulturellen Projektumgebungen zu navigieren

• Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (PMP, IPMA oder gleichwertig) ist ein Vorteil, aber nicht unerlässlich

• fließend Englisch, zusätzliche Sprachen wie Französisch, Italienisch oder Deutsch sind ein Plus

• Eine organisierte, belastbare und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit einer Leidenschaft für die Zusammenarbeit und die Bereitstellung von Mehrwert für Kunden

Wir wissen, dass kein Kandidat alle oben aufgeführten Qualifikationen erfüllt. Wenn Sie von dieser Gelegenheit begeistert sind und glauben, dass Ihre Erfahrung zu unserem Erfolg beitragen kann, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Mehr über uns

descriptionByLocale.fr:

• Favoriser des relations solides avec les intervenants internes et externes pour favoriser l'alignement et la réussite des projets

• Identifier les risques, les possibilités et les initiatives d'amélioration de façon proactive tout en guidant l'équipe à travers les défis et les changements

• Gérer les aspects commerciaux des projets, y compris les contrats, les réclamations, les prévisions et les résultats financiers

• Appuyer les efforts d'amélioration continue et contribuer au partage des connaissances, au mentorat et au développement de l'excellence en gestion de projets au sein de l'organisation

Vos antécédents

• Maîtrise en génie électrique, génie mécanique, génie industriel ou domaine technique connexe

• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la conduite de projets internationaux complexes dans un environnement industriel mondial

• L'expérience acquise au sein des SIG, des sous-stations, du transport d'électricité, des infrastructures énergétiques ou d'industries similaires est très appréciée.

• Être en mesure de diriger l'exécution du projet, la gestion des intervenants et l'engagement des clients

• Abondance commerciale et financière avec l'expérience de la gestion des budgets, des calendriers, des risques et des contrats

• Capacité de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et de naviguer avec succès dans des environnements de projets complexes et multiculturels

• La certification de gestion de projet (PMP, IPMA, ou équivalent) est un avantage mais pas essentiel

• En anglais, des langues supplémentaires comme le français, l'italien ou l'allemand sont un plus

• Une mentalité organisée, résiliente et orientée vers la solution avec une passion pour la collaboration et la valeur pour les clients

Nous savons qu'aucun candidat ne répond à toutes les qualités énumérées ci-dessus. jobs.title: Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics

We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in power electronics and power grid applications to join our Research Center in Baden/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions for a wide range of fast-growing applications like HVDC, energy storage systems and renewables like wind or solar. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!

How you'll make an impact

• You innovate: Transform power electronics modeling, design and optimization by incorporating AI and ML
• You investigate: Perform industrial research in multi-physics modelling and optimization for power electronic systems to create advanced, high-efficiency engineering tools targeting new solutions for power grid applications.
• You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges
• You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors
• You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports
Your background

• PhD in Electrical Engineering specialized in Power Electronics or PhD in Computer Science specialized in AI
• Proven expertise in AI/ML, with a solid understanding of algorithms, frameworks, and extensive experience in Python and relevant software tools
• Ability to apply AI/ML to engineering problems, in particular in the field of power electronics
• Experience in power electronics design and modeling. Know-how in power electronics integration topics such as cooling and mechanical integration, insulation, EMC, and grid integration is considered as a plus
• Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

Dans un environnement interdisciplinaire, vous stimulerez l'innovation de pointe et développerez de nouvelles solutions pour un large éventail d'applications à croissance rapide comme le HVDC, les systèmes de stockage d'énergie et les énergies renouvelables comme l'éolien ou l'énergie solaire. Saisissez cette occasion unique et rejoignez notre équipe motivée pour contribuer à un avenir énergétique durable pour tous !

Vos antécédents

• Doctorat en génie électrique spécialisé en Power Electronics ou Doctorat en informatique spécialisé en AI
• Expertise éprouvée en AI/ML, avec une solide compréhension des algorithmes, des cadres et une vaste expérience en Python et des outils logiciels pertinents
• Capacité d'appliquer l'IA/ML aux problèmes d'ingénierie, en particulier dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance
• Expérience dans la conception et la modélisation de l'électronique de puissance. Le savoir-faire en matière d'intégration de l'électronique de puissance comme le refroidissement et l'intégration mécanique, l'isolation, l'EMC et l'intégration du réseau est considéré comme un plus
• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, attitude de joueur d'équipe, initiative et créativité
Plus sur nous

Chez Hitachi Energy, nous croyons au pouvoir de la diversité et au potentiel de chaque personne. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun puisse prospérer. Nous vous invitons à postuler et à nous rejoindre pour façonner un avenir durable.

jobs.title: GCB Tendering Manager (80–100%) (f/m/d)

• Build and maintain strong customer relationships, proactively identifying maintenance opportunities and promoting value-added service offerings across the installed base
• Prepare, coordinate, and follow up on commercial quotations, ensuring competitive, accurate, and profitable offers that are converted into successful orders
• Own and manage the sales pipeline for the assigned markets, maintaining forecast accuracy, driving opportunity progression, and reducing overdue quotations

• Fluent in English; German and other languages are a plus
• Team oriented, structured, and customer focused mindset

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today!

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues.

• Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line.

• Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects.

• Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC).

• Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line.

• Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production.

• Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay.

• On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers.

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience

• Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing)

• Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis

• Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography

• Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred

• Good English and German language skills

• Ability to work in a cleanroom environment

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

In qualità di Ingegnere Fotolitico, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi!

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Assicurarsi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti.

• Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione.

• Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo.

• Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC).

• Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità.

• Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay.

• I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call.

Il tuo sfondo

• Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore

• Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore)

• Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati

• Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione

• La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita

• Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today!

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues.

• Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line.

• Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects.

• Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC).

• Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line.

• Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production.

• Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay.

• On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers.

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience

• Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing)

• Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis

• Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography

• Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred

• Good English and German language skills

• Ability to work in a cleanroom environment

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo.

• Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay.

• I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call.

Il tuo sfondo

• Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore)

• Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati

• Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione

• La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito

jobs.title: Operator Anlagenbetreuer/in Prüflabor 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position
In dieser Funktion erwartet dich eine herausfordernde und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, bei der du als technisch versierter Allrounder mit Weitblick unser Hochleistungslabor verstärken. Zusammen mit unseren Prüfingenieuren führst du Versuche mit Leistungsschaltern durch. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und stellst sicher, dass der Betrieb reibungslos verläuft, unsere Prüfanlage mit Kurzschlussgenerator technisch einwandfrei funktioniert und agierst aktiv bei Störfällen.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Einrichtung der Prüfanlage für den Betrieb

• Vorbereitung und Aufbau von Messungen und Versuchen

• Bedienung des Kurzschlussgenerators sowie andere für die Versuche erforderlichen Steuereinrichtungen und Messinstrumente

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Ablaufs der Anlage im operativen Prüfbetrieb

• Instandhalten, Erweitern und Erneuern von elektrischen und mechanischen Anlagen im Hochleistungslabor

• Unterstützung bei Wartungsarbeiten und notwendigen Revisionen an der Anlage (Hilfsschalter, Generator, etc.)

• Erstellung von Dokumentationen zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten und Revisionen

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Fachausbildung in einem elektrotechnischen Beruf

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im sicheren Umgang mit Elektrizität

• Berufserfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Anlagen und/oder Kraftwerken

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Idealerweise Kenntnisse in der elektrische Anlagentechnik im Prüflaborbetrieb, sowie in Leittechnik, Messtechnik, Steuerungstechnik

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Hubarbeitsbühnen und Hallenkranen von Vorteil

Mehr über uns
Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
In questo ruolo, ci si può aspettare un compito impegnativo e variegato, in cui, come all-rounder tecnicamente esperto con la vista, rafforzare il nostro laboratorio ad alte prestazioni. Insieme ai nostri tecnici di prova, effettuerete test con interruttori di circuito. Siete la persona di contatto centrale e assicuratevi che l'operazione funzioni senza intoppi, il nostro sistema di prova con generatore di cortocircuito funziona tecnicamente impeccabile e agisce attivamente in caso di guasti.

Puoi farlo.

• Istituzione della struttura di prova operativa

• Preparazione e costruzione di misurazioni e test

• Funzionamento del generatore di cortocircuito e altri dispositivi di controllo e strumenti di misura necessari per i test

• Assicurarsi che l'installazione funzioni senza problemi nelle operazioni di test operativi

• Manutenzione, ampliamento e rinnovo di apparecchiature elettriche e meccaniche in un laboratorio ad alte prestazioni

• Supporto per lavori di manutenzione e ispezioni di installazione necessarie (interruttore ausiliario, generatore, ecc.)

• Preparazione della documentazione sui lavori effettuati e revisioni

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione professionale completa in una professione elettrotecnica

• Conoscenza del suono nella gestione sicura dell'elettricità

• Esperienza professionale nella manutenzione di impianti e/o centrali elettriche

• Buone competenze tedesche, le competenze inglesi sono vantaggiose

• Idealmente, la conoscenza nella tecnologia degli impianti elettrici nel funzionamento del laboratorio di prova, nonché nella tecnologia di controllo, nella tecnologia di misura, nella tecnologia di controllo

In this role, you can expect a challenging and varied task, in which you, as a technically-savvy all-rounder with foresight, strengthen our high-performance laboratory. Together with our test engineers, you will carry out tests with circuit breakers. You are the central contact person and ensure that the operation runs smoothly, our test system with short-circuit generator works technically flawlessly and actively acts in the event of failures.

• Operation of the short-circuit generator and other control devices and measuring instruments required for the tests

• Ensure that the installation runs smoothly in operational test operations

• Professional experience in plant and/or power plant maintenance

• Good German skills, English skills are advantageous

• Ideally, knowledge in electrical plant technology in test laboratory operation, as well as in control technology, measurement technology, control technology

• Experience in handling lifting work platforms and hall cranes is advantageous

More about us
Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow their skills.

jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas-Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods.

As a Project Lead Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end execution of gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) projects, ensuring seamless coordination from initial planning to final delivery. You will oversee technical design, procurement, and stakeholder interactions, ensuring that all aspects of the project align with quality standards, budget constraints, and deadlines. • Project Management & Tools: Experience with SAP, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and scheduling tools

• Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve project-related issues efficiently

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas-Insulated Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia.

In qualità di Project Lead Engineer, sarai responsabile dell'esecuzione end-to-end dei progetti di switchgear (GIS) isolati a gas, garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità dalla pianificazione iniziale alla consegna finale. Potrai supervisionare la progettazione tecnica, gli appalti e le interazioni degli stakeholder, assicurando che tutti gli aspetti del progetto si allineano con standard di qualità, vincoli di bilancio e scadenze. La vostra esperienza nell'ingegneria, nella gestione dei progetti e nella collaborazione interfunzionale sarà essenziale per ottimizzare i processi, guidare l'innovazione e fornire risultati eccezionali ai clienti.

A Hitachi Energy, sappiamo che il grande talento viene in molte forme. Se siete interessati a questo ruolo, ma non soddisfare ogni esigenza, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare. La vostra esperienza unica e la vostra prospettiva potrebbe essere esattamente quello che stiamo cercando.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Project Planning & Execution: Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto tecnici, garantendo l'allineamento con i requisiti del cliente, le normative del settore e i processi interni

• Ingegneria & Documentazione tecnica: Preparare e rivedere documenti di ingegneria, come specifiche tecniche, disegni, istruzioni di montaggio e liste materiali

• Stakeholder & Customer Coordina: Servire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per clienti, team di ingegneria interna, fornitori e subappaltatore

• Gestione delle catene di materiali e di alimentazione: Definire i requisiti dei materiali, supervisionare gli appalti e garantire le configurazioni corrette per la fabbricazione e il montaggio

• Budget & Timeline Control: monitorare i costi del progetto, monitorare i progressi contro le scadenze e implementare azioni correttive secondo le necessità

• Quality Assurance & Process Improvement: Identificare e risolvere problemi tecnici, guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo e garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità

• Supporto del sito & Commissioning: fornire assistenza tecnica in loco durante le fasi di installazione, test e messa in servizio

Il tuo sfondo

• Qualifiche educative: laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo correlato

• Min 5 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del progetto, idealmente in commutatore isolato a gas (GIS), trasmissione di potenza, o relative apparecchiature ad alta tensione

• Competenze tecniche: competenza nel software CAD (Creo, AutoCAD) per la progettazione e la documentazione ingegneristica

• Gestione del progetto e strumenti: esperienza con SAP, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) e strumenti di programmazione

• Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di identificare e risolvere i problemi legati al progetto in modo efficiente

• Collaborazione trasversale: Capacità di coordinare tra più squadre, tra cui R&D, produzione, approvvigionamento e garanzia di qualità

• Esperienza internazionale: lavoro confortevole in un ambiente globale, collaborazione con diversi stakeholder e adattamento a diverse culture di lavoro

• Lingua e viaggio: fluente in inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco è un plus

• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente per incontri di progetto e visite al sito

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Project Quality Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our international project organization and  drive quality across large and complex projects. In this role, you will work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and site organizations to ensure that quality requirements are understood, implemented, and continuously improved.

You will act as a trusted quality partner to the Project Manager, helping the team achieve project objectives, manage risks, and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines technical quality expertise with strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan, organize, lead, and monitor quality-related project activities, resources, objectives, KPIs, and deliverables

• Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Plan and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and the ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System

• Collaborate closely with project teams, suppliers, site organizations, and other key stakeholders

• Lead and follow up on project quality audits, non-conformances, corrective actions, lessons learned, quality risks, and continuous improvement activities

• Monitor and report relevant quality indicators, including non-conformance reports, customer complaint resolution, cost of poor quality, project savings, and customer satisfaction

• Coordinate quality requirements for critical equipment, including supplier documentation, Inspection and Test Plans, Master Test Plans, inspections, and shipment-release reviews

• Support site quality activities, including training, audits, inspections, documentation handover, and project close-out

• Promote a strong quality culture and use structured problem-solving and lean methodologies to improve quality throughout project execution

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or a related field; a master's degree is an advantage

• At least five years of professional experience in EPC project quality management within a large and complex organization; experience in the power, energy, renewable energy, or oil and gas sectors is preferred

• Sound knowledge of ISO 9001; internal-auditor certification is considered an advantage

• Good understanding on SAP Quality Module as well as  project and risk management; knowledge of PMI methodologies or CAPM-PMI certification is beneficial

• Experience with supplier and site quality processes, including Inspection and Test Plans, PPAP, inspections, testing procedures, punch lists, mechanical completion, and lessons learned

• Knowledge of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, root cause analysis, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma, and FMEA

• Excellent English communication skills, combined with a structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and collaborative working style; German or other additional languages are an advantage

• Confidence working in an international matrix environment and willingness to travel to project construction sites and supplier locations when required

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Conoscenza delle metodologie di qualità e risoluzione dei problemi come 8D, analisi della causa radice, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma e FMEA

• Eccellente capacitÃ di comunicazione inglese, combinata con uno stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e collaborativo; Tedesco o altre lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio

• Confidenza che lavora in un ambiente di matrice internazionale e la volontà di viaggiare a siti di costruzione di progetto e sedi dei fornitori quando necessario

jobs.title: Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, and grid interconnections.
Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.
To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.
If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation

• Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams

• Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews

• Develop and implement control software, including testing on real-time simulation platforms

• Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site

• Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery

• Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation

• Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management

Your background

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences)

• Hands-on experience with MATLAB / Simulink is essential

• Strong knowledge of process control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus

• Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage

• Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)

• Fluency in English and German

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Additionally, you can expect:

• Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics

• Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications

• A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work

• Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business

• Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung.

• Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen.

• Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz.

• Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

• Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen.

• Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland.

• La conoscenza approfondita della tecnologia ad alta tensione, dei sistemi di commutazione e di controllo è vantaggiosa.

• Uso sicuro delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova.

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura (Swiss tedesco è un vantaggio), così come buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e capacità di pensiero analitico.

• Alto grado di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del cliente.

• Patente di guida valida categoria B.

• Volontà di lavorare ore flessibili e viaggi.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Offriamo attività emozionanti e diversificate con grande ambito creativo e interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e versatili, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un attraente pacchetto di servizi con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di cibo, così come una voce nella scelta di alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The possibility
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers.

You can do that.

• Implementation of installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs of HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution.

• Error analysis and correction of complex electrical equipment and systems.

• Creation of service reports and documentation after each deployment.

• Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options.

• Training of customer personnel in the handling of the facilities.

• Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards.

• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad.

• Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours.

• Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies.

Your background

• Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automatist) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy engineering).

• Several years of professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry.

• In-depth knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is advantageous.

• Safe use of measuring and testing equipment.

• Good knowledge of German in words and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills.

• High degree of initiative, sense of responsibility and customer orientation.

• Valid driving licence category B.

• Willingness to work flexible hours and travel.

More about us
We offer exciting and varied tasks with great creative scope as well as attractive further education and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and versatile activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and food packages as well as a say in the choice of accommodation.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino.
In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements.
Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Please submit your resume in English.

How you'll make an impact

• Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements

• Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing

• Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization)

• Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs

• Identifying/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget

• May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects)

• On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables

Your background

• Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background

• 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors

• Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders

• Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus

• Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded

• Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure

• Team-player able to build and motivate a project team

More about us
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
